reviews.title: Calls keep coming
reviews.text:
I initially joined Cloak and was impressed with what the service offered. Unfortunately, after using it, I became frustrated with one major issue that ultimately led me to cancel my subscription.

When an incoming call comes through, it initially rings on my phone. If I decide I don’t want to answer, I press the red decline button on my phone. However, instead of stopping the call, it continues ringing through the Cloak app multiple additional times. Even after repeatedly pressing the red decline button, the calls continue coming through.

The entire point of having a service like this is to have control over which calls you want to receive and which ones you don’t. If I decline a call, I expect it to stop ringing—not continue trying to reach me four more times through the app.

I liked the concept and initially thought Cloak was a great service, but this issue defeated one of the main reasons I subscribed in the first place. Until this functionality is fixed, I’ve decided to discontinue my subscription.

Great concept, but the call-decline functionality needs work.

reviews.title: Minimal Success
reviews.text: I downloaded this app and subscribed to try and reduce the volume of spam calls I’ve been getting, and it works alright. I like the call guard feature in principle, but it seems to let through anyone who says anything. I get a lot of spam calls offering loans, and the automated voice will start talking immediately about the offer, so it gets let through as a verified caller. Then if I decline the call, Cloaked immediately calls me back with the same call. Then it immediately calls me back if I decline again. It’s not even the spammer calling back, if I look at the transcription, it’s the same automated recording continuing as if I hadn’t declined the call. I assume declining just bounces it back to cloaked, who “re-verifies” the caller then sends it back to me again. But I don’t want to decline the same spam 3 times, that makes the spam problem worse, not better.

reviews.title: Not user friendly zero support
reviews.text: It blocks everything, including known callers that I have made extra sure are on the “allow” list, which I added manually. So far, it’s blocked my kids, my elderly mother, my drs office, m job and for the first time in more than 3 decades, my credit card got hacked. I’ve tried their Ai bot, followed everything it suggested to the letter, reset my phone twice and nothing. I got an email saying I would get a call from support… good thing I wasn’t holding my breath. I tried their AI bot again and it just loops into the same answers, some of which have nothing to do with the question I asked. I’m so done with this. I paid for a year in advance and currently looking at deleting and getting a refund.

reviews.title: Waste of time and money
reviews.text: So I downloaded this app because I was getting a lot of spam calls and it puts on a good front says it finds all these data leaks and it says it’s taking you off of all these call list and everything like that and initially it looks like it’s working the way it said it should and then I tried to get into my email. Usually I don’t have a problem with it but tried different locations to try to get better cell service and it kept coming up with the same air that something was wrong with it so I was curious I deleted and removed the app totally and right after doing that I was able to get right into the email so be careful if you do decide to use this app because it will definitely block things that you want to continue using

reviews.title: Not Worth the Money
reviews.text:

reviews.title: Extremely disappointing experience
reviews.text:
If I could give it -50 stars, I would 

I honestly cannot recommend Cloaked based on my experience. What was supposed to be a spam blocker ended up blocking all of my phone calls and making it extremely difficult to even answer a legitimate call. That completely defeats the purpose of having a phone!

The customer service experience was just as frustrating. There is essentially no real customer service—everything seems to be handled by AI, and trying to get an actual answer or help with a problem is incredibly difficult.

I have now disabled everything, deleted the app, and followed the instructions for removing it from my iPhone. Unfortunately, my phone still isn’t ringing properly, which has been extremely frustrating. I have spent far more time trying to undo the problems caused by this app than I ever should have.

I’m also hoping I received a refund, but I can’t even find clear information about the refund or billing process.

For me, Cloaked was absolutely not worth the time, frustration, or hassle. A spam blocker should make your phone experience easier—not leave you wondering why your phone isn’t ringing and unable to get meaningful customer support.

reviews.title: Re captcha nightmare
reviews.text:

App is buggy and kept crashing. Great idea but for the price I expected to not have to do anything but give them the info to hunt down and delete. Watching the AI fill out the forms incorrectly clicking on don’t advertise to me rather then delete my data was extremely frustrating and I have in cases given these data broker more information using this. Very disappointing….the vpn, calling and email screens were additions I wasn’t interested in but felt like they baked it into the price.

There’s a button where you can allow callers and approve certain callers but that never worked. My wife was “approved “ to call and her call never came through and vice versa. Doctors calls and other important phone calls just weren’t coming through no matter what I did. So if you wanna be completely “cloaked” and have absolutely no one disturb this may be a good option.

Sat on hold for 12 minutes until I was told to leave a voicemail and they would call me back. They haven’t contacted me from the AI chat or the emails I’ve sent to them. I’ve paid for a service on July 26 that should have been easier set up for the additional user. It is now Aug 3 and I still couldn’t get ahold of anyone. I tried all their methods. I’ve spent way too much time trying to resolve an issue that is completely broken from their end. What a frustrating joke this is.

reviews.title: Adv features are not consistent
reviews.text:
I really wanted Cloaked to work because the idea behind it is great. During the first few months, it seemed to do a good job removing my information from legitimate data brokers, and I even noticed fewer spam calls.

Unfortunately, after a recent update that added hundreds of new “removals,” my experience changed. The app started sending deletion requests to companies I’ve never done business with. Instead of reducing my exposure, I began receiving emails asking me to verify or complete my personal information so they could process my request—the exact opposite of what I wanted.

It gives me the impression that the app is adding as many companies as possible, regardless of whether they actually have your data, to make the service appear more appealing. 

The phone screening feature has never worked properly for me despite following the setup instructions, and I rarely use the VPN because it often prevents me from accessing websites. To make matters worse, my spam emails have noticeably increased.

I’m waiting for the next actual scan in August before deciding whether to keep my subscription or cancel it.

reviews.title: Deceitful Marketing; Prepare For More Ad Targetting
reviews.text:
Unclear
When I first entered in my information into Cloaked’s website I was very surprised to see that they were able to find my full SSN with very little data. While they only displayed the first 3 numbers of it, I figured this was just a safety measure for identity theft.

So, I signed up for a paid subscription of Cloaked under the pretense they could remove it everywhere online. However, as I started to use Cloaked and became familiar with the app, I quickly learned that there was no way to monitor if my SSN was removed unless I gave it to them; yet they had demonstrated their ability to find it online and had fear mongered me over it.

This made me question whether the first three digits they showed me was actually all they had, and that perhaps my entire SSN wasn’t on the internet. Because of this, I wasn’t comfortable giving them my SSN.

Additionally, I have since learned that it isn’t possible for them to remove it anyway; yet they market as though they can remove data breaches. Cloaked will reach out to various data brokers and ASK them to remove my data, with no guarantee that the process will be completed. Other websites can do this for free. They are not actually capable of taking down data breaches, including SSNs.

Lastly, prior to starting my paid subscription with Cloaked, I would NEVER get targeted ads and I would never receive political messaging. However, shortly after I cancelled my membership due to their unclear marketing, I started receiving extremely

reviews.title: Thought it was amazing UNTIL…
reviews.text:
I used the google search feature on this app to remove my personal information etc…. I immediately got concerned because multiple queries about dogs showed up and Cloaked said “Exposed: 5 results containing your personal information “ and they listed my name and number… I assumed maybe someone was running a scam to sell dogs or something, so I googled the same titles from the Reddit, aol and other results- when I clicked on every single one of them they had ZERO to do with me… not even my first name!! Then I ran the same feature within 15 min of the other and this time it came up with 10 results: all pertaining to either a LGBTQ cruise, a post that said Big gay cruise, or Disney- no dogs in this search result. Once again. ZERO to do with me! 

So, now how can I trust all of the other features I was impressed with and assumed they were working? Now I seriously doubt that those other features really even work. There’s a good chance this whole app is a scam! It is probably not removing anything or protecting your information because it can’t even pull up a simple google search result!! And in all actuality, how do we even know it’s not stealing information? I find it weird they ask for your social security number- it’s not mandatory for signing up or scanning, but that’s just weird… why would I provide some app with everything including my social security number so the possibility of an employee or creators use my info for data mining, more spam or stealing?!

reviews.title: Dark web and racism
reviews.text:
I use this, and was utterly appalled to see an ad on FB that was openly racist. It started with a voiceover of someone speaking flawless English with an accent from the India/Pakistan/Bangladesh Subcontinent. It featured a white mustachioed alpha male-looking tool who informed the accented caller that he was now using this product. The clearly AI-generated voice was portrayed as being afraid of this app. As the voice rose higher and higher and the male voice started saying please, this racist responded with a rapidly widening grin. He was taunting the voice that was programmed to express fear. It was performative cruelty. I felt sick. 

People who work at data centers are humans. Blame our corporate overlords not the person working in hell for the intrusion. I’m canceling my subscription. Please do the same. There are other, more effective apps, to control security. Don’t support racists. 

Furthermore, I know that my SSN is on the dark web. I have lots of identity theft insurance, but I keep trying things to fix the problem. This app is another failed experiment. Plus, I’m still getting lots of spam calls.

reviews.title: It’s hard to prove the future
reviews.text: I have not seen a difference in the amount of spam calls, emails, or texts I get daily.  I’ve had the app for a month and you have to actively go into the app and make sure it’s still deleting you from places. The spam calls and texts haven’t slowed at all. I still get 3-6 spam calls and 3-6 spam texts every single day. I know they want me to pay for a phone number, but if they’ve actually deleted it from these sites I’d at least expect to see less. I think it’s a waste of money and I believe I could buy a new phone number, give it to no one, and I’d still get spam.

reviews.title: Unusable App and poor customer service
reviews.text: I paid for the subscription only for this site to be unusable. Contacting support has been the BIGGEST pain. Every time I try to set up a phone number or enable call forwarding or use a pack, it stays in the loading phase and just times out. Nothing works. Contacted support and when a human finally answered, all he did was say I didn’t need a password. I immediately sent him screenshots of what I was talking about as his answer had nothing to do with my issues, and he never responded. He’s been inactive for 30+ minutes. This is SO frustrating because I was REALLY hoping this would help me but instead all it’s caused was headaches and took my money.

reviews.title: Disastrous experience — caused a flood of spam and blocked legit calls.
reviews.text:
Before trying Cloaked, I was getting about 4 to 5 spam calls a day. Within the very first hour of switching to Cloaked, I was slammed with 5 spam calls in the morning alone. It completely backfired. I had to scramble to turn my AT&T ActiveArmor back on, which took hours because AT&T requires a waiting period before you can re-subscribe. While AT&T's free service isn't perfect, it is way more efficient than Cloaked.

Furthermore, Cloaked completely fails to mention a massive technical catch: if you choose to receive calls through their app instead of your native phone app, you must have a flawless internet connection. If your connection dips, even legitimate, critical calls will NOT go through.

Their service is extremely overpriced for the poor performance they deliver; honestly, it isn't worth more than $2 a month. If you are looking for effective data removal and privacy, skip Cloaked and look into Incogni or Aura instead. They actually do what they claim to do.

reviews.title: Benefit Unlikely
reviews.text:
I don’t think this has much value add for me. The main thing I want is spam call screening and the built in iPhone options do the same thing cloaked is doing. The voicemail screening voice is a male one and there is no option to make it a woman’s voice or my voice so it would sound insane to legitimate callers. My calls and texts aren’t decreasing so the filter is not of much use. I wish I hadn’t paid for a full year.

Some information was removed using the other options but frankly the spam calls and texts are much higher priority for me given I’ve done what I can to protect my identity and credit elsewhere.

reviews.text: I installed cloaked to get rid of the continuous notifications and protection. But it didn’t happen !! I got even more notifications it was driving nuts so I went to cancel and I had a hard time canceling after several attempts to keep me on as a customer they finally told me how to do it so I have but I still have cloaked on every silent call I get I have to go into the phone to see who called on those calls. But I don’t receive voicemails anymore so I have no ideal who left a message. I updated my IOS and my phone wouldn’t work right and it was because of cloaked . So I removed the app. I turned off the VPN AND I STILL HAVE CLOAKED.  Once a cloaked customer I guess you are a customer for life whether you want it or not . NO Thank You CLOAKED

reviews.title: Can be useful, but I lost all trust for them.
reviews.text:
First off, all this app does is automate and simplify things that anyone can otherwise do themselves. And it does a pretty good job at it. Especially if someone was unaware that they can submit forms to remove themselves from various lists, change their phone settings, etc.

So for that reason, I actually would have recommended them at least for a one time or short term basis. And maybe you could argue that some level of monitoring is a good thing. 

The thing is, if you’re not actively doing that after setup, it’s just another one of those rogue subscription fees you pay. 

So then when I go through the cancellation process….these (insert unkind cuss word)’s have users go through and turn off all of the iPhone native spam protection features — that have ABSOLUTELY NOTHING to do with Cloaked — before taking you to the actual cancel button. As in, the spam controls, unknown call forwarding, etc that is built in your phone. 

So if for the sake of a lame retention attempt and their own bottom line, they’re willing to actively cause harm to their own former customers, why the hell would I trust them with full access to my phone, let alone pay them?

reviews.title: This app doesn’t work
reviews.text:
So the app was not working when I first signed up it wouldn’t let me save any information, support wouldn’t respond for days at a time, finally they said they fixed the issue, so I re signed up. It was letting me save info finally after the update. Now the VPN disconnected itself days ago and again support won’t respond all you get is this AI help screen that doesn’t understand what you are telling it. I think they keep releasing updates and this is the only app I have that won’t update automatically. This way when ur identity gets stolen they can say you didn’t update the app so they get out of Paying the coverage. I have seen no drop in the amount of spam calls or emails since I started this and the thing is saying it’s removed 793 exposures. If you look almost all of that claims to
Be data broker sites but I’m beginning to believe this is an AI app that makes it look like it’s doing something but it’s doing nothing. 
Definitely buyer beware on this app.

reviews.title: Support and communication are a disaster
reviews.text:
Absolutely one of the most frustrating subscription apps I have used in years.

I paid for an annual Couple plan and the app suddenly blocked me from creating numbers with a vague “temporarily paused” message and almost no explanation. No warning. No clear rules. No onboarding explaining what you should or should not do with identities and numbers.

Apparently deleting numbers while trying to learn the app can get your account restricted, but nowhere do they clearly explain that. Instead of educating paying customers, the system quietly punishes them.

Support is a mess. One support email bounced back, parts of the help system produced server errors, and contacting an actual human feels intentionally difficult. For a company built around communication and privacy, that is embarrassing.

The entire experience feels unfinished and poorly thought out for a premium paid service. Customers should not have to reverse-engineer how an app works while risking account restrictions.

I wanted to like Cloaked because the concept is good, but the execution and customer communication are terrible. At this point I would strongly recommend people look at MySudo instead. It appears to have a much clearer workflow, more transparency, and a more mature overall user experience.

I will not be renewing.

reviews.title: Not worth the expense
reviews.text: An expensive product that failed to actually DO anything except make me miss phone calls.  I know my data must be all over based solely on the 30+ spam calls I get a day.  I had high hopes for this and was very disappointed.  The initial scan removed my info from 1 location on the first day… nothing after that.  Using cloaked didn’t lessen the number of calls, it just guaranteed the calls I needed to know about would end up inaccessible and the AI call review would let through any call that mumbled words from another AI bot.  I paid for a year and I’m canceling within the 30 days (of course they don’t make that easy… isn’t that against new regulations?)

reviews.title: Put my life in danger
reviews.text: Once I loaded the app, instead of filtering the calls, which is what it was set to do, it glitched, according to Cloaked and has blocked all incoming and outgoing calls. And unfortunately, that includes me trying to make a 911 emergency call. When I called the police department instead of them picking up, I got a message that said that they do not receive numbers that have been blocked or hidden. I presently have an active stalker who at this minute is in jail and about to be released on bond and will be very angry. And this app on my phone, which I have already gone through the process via their chat assistance to remove its functioning off of my phone, so there would no longer block the calls and have tried numerous times and it is not removing it, and I still cannot make an emergency phone call. Presently it has my life in danger and the best it could do was take my information and let me know that on the next available workday after 9 AM somebody would contact me by email. This is completely unacceptable and I am fearful for anyone who downloads the app to their phone and is unaware until they are in a dire situation and try to get a hold of the police department and find out that their 911 calls will not go through. The lack of human customer service available 24 hours for an app that is supposed to be protecting your security, but is yet putting your life in danger is completely unacceptable.

reviews.title: Ripoff company you’ll regret using them eventually when you try to cancel/delete the service
reviews.text: First off my experience with their service was bad. The interface was over complicated and it interfered with my contacts getting ahold of me. Now this company won’t allow me to simply cancel their program and continually charges me every month. Ive sent several emails and I had to jump through a bunch of hoops trying to have my account cancelled/deleted. They sent me to a website with page after page full of questions wanting to know why I’m cancelling. After going back and forth with them they stopped sending email responses by a live agent and the last few were automated. I haven’t had a response back in a while and I’m still being charged after weeks trying. I am going to file a chargeback to get my money back and I won’t ever use them again.
